text:
maria: Quick thread to lock down the design-partner (DP) recruitment + feedback ops. Goal: 2 staggered cohorts (10 partners each), 4-week pilots, measurable handoff to sales/product. Need intake form, screening rubric, onboarding checklist, compensation bands, and a lightweight metrics dashboard.

kevin: Eng capacity: can support 5 concurrent partners fully instrumented. With automation (templates + onboarding scripts) can scale to 12. For 20 total we'll stagger by week and keep a 2-person ops rota. Need clarity on SSO and dataset access for regulated partners.

sam: UX will deliver two short deliverables: (1) 6-task usability template that partners run week 0 and week 3, (2) prompt-eval template (10 golden prompts). Recommend weekly 15m show-and-tell + optional Loom demos. Short surveys only (3-5 Qs).

ashok: CS acceptance signals: 70% weekly active usage, one core feature used by >=20% of flows, and blocker response <=48h. We'll require partners to file support tickets in the shared board; major blockers escalate to on-call. Refund/credit policy if core SLA missed.

juno: Draft intake form (minimal):
```
- org_name
- contact_name + email + timezone
- size
- primary_use_case (one line)
- estimated_monthly_tokens
- data_sensitivity: public|internal|regulated
- sso_needed: yes/no
- nda_ok: checkbox
- preferred_start_windows (week1/week3)
```

maria: Compensation bands: Tier 1 (launch partners) = $5k credits + co-marketing; Tier 2 (pilots) = 50% off first 3 months; Tier 3 = credits only. Keep legal to NDA + short pilot terms doc. No MSAs at this stage.

kevin: Ops guardrails: require canary rule for infra/model changes affecting partners. If partner evals show >5% quality regression on their eval set, pause change for affected cohort and notify partners. Reserve small "rescue" capacity and a health-check script we can run with partners.

sam: Feedback loop: weekly automated evals on partner prompt sets (run by infra), Notion dashboard per partner (latency p50/p95, errors, quality delta), weekly digest + internal triage. Capture anecdotes in free-text doc.

ashok: Success checklist proposal: onboarding <=5 business days, latency p50 <200ms, error rate <1%, NPS >=8 at end of week 4, feature adoption >=20% of tracked flows. If metrics fail by week 6, create remediation plan or offer partial credit.

maria: Screening rubric: prioritize realistic production workloads, diversity of verticals, at least one regulated-sensitivity partner for Private onboarding, and mix of small/medium/enterprise for scale testing.

ops-bot: Reminder: this thread added to project 'dp-beta-run'. Deadlines assigned.

maria: Action items: @kevin onboarding + runbook draft by Tue COB; @sam feedback templates + dashboard skeleton by Wed; @ashok SLA + compensation terms draft by Fri; @juno intake form + outreach copy by Mon EOD. We'll do a 30m alignment Tue 10am if drafts look good.
